item.title: [DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Thu 19:17): IT-Sicherheitslücke | Asylverfahren am BER | Bierpinsel bröckelt
item.description:
Originally published Thu 22 Oct 2026 19:17 IDT.
Wegen einer weltweiten Sicherheitslücke haben viele Einrichtungen ihre Internetseiten vorsorglich vom Netz genommen oder eingeschränkt. Betroffen ist die weit verbreitete Programmiersprache PHP. Außerdem: Amazon-Verteilzentrum. Asylverfahren am BER. Berliner Bierpinsel marode.   "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Fri 07:46): Yemen's humanitarian crisis
item.description:
Originally published Fri 23 Oct 2026 07:46 IDT.

Our senior international corrrespondent Orla Guerin reports from Yemen where fighting has intensified between government forces and Houthi rebels. Also: Kim Jong-un's sister, Kim Yo-jong steps into the limelight as rumours swirl over the health of the North Korean leader. Demonstrators stage peaceful protests across Venezuela calling for the safe return of opposition leader Maria Corina Machado. President Trump is ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit. New York city council votes to ban the use of horsedrawn carriages in Central Park after a long campaign by activists who say the animals suffer. A retired decorator becomes a millionaire after Pokemon cards sold at auction. And Raye wins the 2026 Mercury Prize for her album This Music May Contain Hope.

The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world. Politics, economics, climate, business, technology, health – we cover it all with expert analysis and insight.
